params.name: projectId
params.description:
ID of the project whose daily storage summaries you want to retrieve.
You can get your project ID from the [API Credentials](https://console.eon.io/global-management/api-credentials) page in your global management console.

params.name: startDate
params.description: First day of the date range in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

params.name: endDate
params.description: Last day of the date range in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

items.docs: Description: Retrieves a list of snapshot storage sizes per day for the given date range.
